entities.summary: Liberal, a notable figure in the history of Switzerland, associated with Federal Constitution & Modern Switzerland (1830–1848). Preceded by Federal Constitution. Their legacy influenced Swiss Federal Constitution establishes modern federal state and Henry Dunant founds the International Committee of the Red Cross.
